purpose: Resolve the V4 three-parameter confound by varying one netem parameter at a time while holding the others fixed. Determines which configured parameter the frozen dispersion-persistence observation responds to.
development_exclusion: All V1-V4 captures are excluded from V5 estimation and from any parameter selection.
design: One factor varied per arm from a common reference point. The reference is the V4 benign condition.

A_reference_benign.note: reference arm, reproduces the V4 benign condition

B_loss_only.note: adds ONLY loss to the reference

C_jitter_only.note: adds ONLY the larger jitter to the reference

D_delay_only.note: adds ONLY the larger mean delay to the reference

E_full_v4_impairment.note: positive control, identical to the V4 impairment condition

prespecified_interpretation.if_only_B_and_E_positive: the observation is attributable to configured loss
prespecified_interpretation.if_only_C_and_E_positive: the observation is attributable to configured jitter magnitude
prespecified_interpretation.if_only_D_and_E_positive: the observation is attributable to configured mean delay
prespecified_interpretation.if_multiple_single_factor_arms_positive: the observation responds to more than one factor; report each
prespecified_interpretation.if_E_positive_but_no_single_factor_arm_p: the observation requires a combination; no single-parameter attribution is supported
prespecified_interpretation.if_A_positive: the reference arm itself triggers; the V4 control result does not reproduce and the whole comparison is void pending investigation

execution_constraints: Same frozen runner, detector, validator and thresholds as V4. No retuning.
Interleave arms A,B,C,D,E within each repetition so host-load drift is spread across arms.
Preserve every failed attempt with its reason. Never delete a run directory.
If an arm cannot be executed exactly as frozen, preserve the failure and report it; do not substitute.

analysis.no_retuning: No threshold, arm, or inclusion change after the first V5 capture without superseding this protocol.

decision_boundary: V5 can attribute the observation to a configured netem parameter under these software conditions only. It cannot establish receiver harm, attack detection, physical timing quality, or recovery.

runner_and_validator_versioning.reason: V5 needs three single-variable arms the V4 runner does not implement. The V4 runner and validator were NOT modified; they remain byte-identical so V4 stays reproducible.
runner_and_validator_versioning.delta: Adds scenarios v5_loss_only, v5_jitter_only, v5_delay_only, each emitting v5_netem_command_confirmed. Detector engines and all thresholds are unchanged.
